image_description: A beige and brown minibus parked on a paved street with buildings in the background. The vehicle features a boxy shape, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. There is text on the front destination board and side panels.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a compact, boxy silhouette distinct from full-size coaches, with sufficient roof height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is prominent, and multiple side windows are visible along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width, and a sliding door track/panel is visible near the front wheel arch.
The paneling and track lines near the front wheel indicate a sliding door mechanism typical of this vehicle class.
There is a distinct hood/bonnet section ahead of the windshield, indicating a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is not visible in this three-quarter front view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus features a two-tone beige and brown livery with red stripe accents, consistent with commercial transport markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, appearing as standard heavy-duty van/truck rims.
The window configuration and overall dimensions align with a vehicle designed for small group transport.

artifact_observations.location: Front destination sign and side panel text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the destination board and side panels is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear characters.
The front grille and bumper geometry appears warped and inconsistent, with headlights merging into the bodywork without clear boundaries.
The front wheel appears slightly elliptical and the contact patch with the ground is soft/blurry, lacking sharp physical grounding.
Small protruding details like mirrors and handles lack crisp edges and appear slightly melted or fused with the door panel.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific vehicle class and distinguish it from similar categories like vans or full-size buses.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text artifacts observed on the vehicle.
To check for boundary bleeding and structural coherence in the complex front-end geometry.
To verify correct spatial grounding and perspective consistency of the wheels against the pavement.
To assess global image quality and detect subtle texture inconsistencies or generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Text legibility on destination board and side panels
Structural integrity of front grille and headlights
Wheel geometry and ground contact shadows
Boundary sharpness of side mirrors and door handles
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts; AI often fails to render coherent text on vehicles. Also, scrutinize the front end for 'melting' where headlights meet the bumper, as this is a common failure mode in vehicle generation. Check if the wheels are perfectly circular or if they show slight elliptical distortion due to perspective errors.
